title: Samsung says Ballie, a robot announced six years ago but never released, is an "active innovation platform" within the company helping inform other products (Chris Welch/Bloomberg)
summary: Chris Welch / Bloomberg: Samsung says Ballie, a robot announced six years ago but never released, is an “active innovation platform” within the company helping inform other products — Samsung Electronics Co. has once again sidelined Ballie, a long-anticipated robot that was first announced six years ago but never released.
